# P17: Checked within F11: Find-and-pick fits a phone, and a choice is never a capsule (F11, P17)

A check of the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/finish/10-pickers.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured, and a limit its words don’t give is added after it, in the script’s test (“its test: …”).

## What it checks

F11 (with P17): find-and-pick on a phone and a computer (docs/design/find/spec.md, section 7). On a 390 px phone an open picker's first result is near the top, its rows are at least 44 px high and nothing scrolls sideways; on both, a chosen person is plain words with a button, never a capsule (no rounded, filled box behind it). A picker inside a sheet is a full sheet of its own on a phone.

## Where it looks

- 390 × 844, as rhea, at `/reviews/new`
- 1440 × 900, as rhea, at `/reviews/new`
- 390 × 844, as tunde, at `/settings`

A width of 390 is a phone, 1440 (or 1280) a desktop; the address is in the demo on Thursday 5 November 2026 unless it names another day. {…} is a value the script works out as it runs.

## What it reports as wrong

- {w}: the first suggestion starts at {Math.round(m.first)} px, not within 200 px of the top (its test: `m.first < 0`)
- {w}: picker rows {m.heights.join('/')} px high (at least 44)
- {w}: the page scrolls sideways by {m.sideways} px with a picker open (its test: `m.sideways > 1`)
- {w}: a chosen value is drawn as a capsule ({caps.join(', ')})
- 390: a picker in a sheet covers {b ? `${Math.round(b.y)} to ${Math.round(b.y + b.height)} px` : 'nothing'}, not the whole screen (its test: `b.y > 1`, `b.y + b.height < 843`)
